migx_program_study.questions-text:
Theory module:

migx_program_study.questions-text: Every student who pays in advance gets a free, complete theory module that will be covered during the semi-permanent makeup course. By studying it beforehand, you can go deeper into the theory and spend more time on practice.

migx_questions_study.questions-title-bl15: Can I buy supplies from the school after the course?
migx_questions_study.questions-text-bl15: Yes, basic supplies are available for sale. At the school you can buy a permanent makeup machine, pigments and additional supplies. However, you are under no obligation to buy anything from us. You can buy your starter equipment wherever is convenient for you.

migx_questions_study.questions-title-bl15: Do I need a medical education or training?
migx_questions_study.questions-text-bl15: It is not required. A permanent makeup artist can work without a medical background. However, it will be an advantage for your future work.

migx_questions_study.questions-title-bl15: What do I need to buy for the eyebrow micropigmentation course?
migx_questions_study.questions-text-bl15: Nothing. Our school provides everything you need.

migx_questions_study.questions-title-bl15: I'm already an artist. Can this micropigmentation and microblading course be useful to me?
migx_questions_study.questions-text-bl15: There is always room to improve your skills and learn modern techniques. We offer training in powder brows, upper/lower lash line tattooing and aquarelle lips.

migx_advantages_study.advantages-title: We don't limit your choice. You can train in one, two or three areas. Together we will look at your preferences and suggest the most effective option.
We have developed a unique program that balances theory and practice, so we can cover all the information and fully put it into practice in the hands-on sessions.
The LBar tattoo school has been running since 2018. Hundreds of our graduates have become successful artists. We can find an individual approach to every student.
We provide absolutely everything you need for the training: from a notebook and pen to a well-organized workstation. You will work with professional equipment.
Your trainer will always be by your side, supervising your work and gently guiding you if any mistakes are noticed. Our goal is to help you produce flawless work.
Practical sessions are done on live models provided by the school. You can also invite your loved ones or friends as models.
The training takes place in a friendly, relaxed atmosphere. Nobody will pressure you during the course, but we do expect you to take an active part in the learning process. Work at your best!
You will learn how to become a sought-after specialist. We will explain how to work in a highly competitive field and earn more than your competitors.
